purpose: Comparable generic Android LLM execution and performance measurement; podcast transcript quality evaluation is out of scope.

setup_boundary.start: Immediately before the first model/tokenizer file access or runtime creation, whichever occurs first.
setup_boundary.end: The loaded route can accept a canonical request without additional model loading, initial runtime/session creation, accelerator compilation, or initial KV allocation. Later per-request reset or fresh-Session creation is measured separately.
included: model and tokenizer file open or mapping
accelerator compilation when performed at runtime
initial KV-cache allocation required for readiness

timing.request_to_first_token: Immediately before workload rendering/tokenization through delivery of the first generated token ID to the benchmark caller.
timing.prefill: Submission of effective prompt tokens to the model through readiness of the final prompt token KV state.
timing.post_prefill_to_first_token: Prefill completion through delivery of the first generated token ID.
timing.decode: First generated-token delivery through final generated-token delivery; throughput counts tokens after the first over that interval.
timing.total_request: The request-to-first-token start boundary through final output or stop delivery.
timing.request_state_reset_or_session_creation: Measured separately before each logical request, with an explicit statement of whether it is included in total request; it must not include model remapping/reloading or accelerator recompilation.

output_sanity.scope: Superficial exact-output-hash corruption/gibberish smoke check only; not quality, correctness, grounding, usefulness, or acceptance.

required_evidence: exact model identity, source revision, artifact hashes, format, and size
exact quantization scheme and tool provenance
exact tokenizer revision and model-native chat-template provenance
rendered prompt SHA-256, effective input-token count, and token-ID SHA-256
device, Android build, runtime, provider, thread, and accelerator configuration
per-request TTFT, prefill, decode, total latency, and throughput observations
per-request isolation strategy and reset or fresh-Session creation duration, including whether it is inside total-request timing
actual generated-token count and stop reason
peak memory with method, sampling interval, and lifecycle semantics
thermal and power context or null with explicit reasons
every raw UTF-8 output path, byte count, and SHA-256
exact-hash output sanity using only looks_sensible and issue_notes
missing values represented as null with explicit reasons
